regime.call: Chip-led risk-off intensifies as AI capex fears spread
contradicts: RSP/SPY rose 1.93% and IWM/SPY rose 1.26% today, a pattern that normally signals risk-on breadth widening, but it coincides with a 6.72% SOX plunge and a Fear & Greed reading of 19, so it looks like defensive flight out of concentrated AI/semis exposure rather than genuine risk appetite.

falsifiers.meaning: Would show the chip-sector selloff reversing fast, meaning today's move was a one-day event rather than a trend change.
Would show today's volatility spike fading quickly, meaning the rising-volatility axis call was premature.

falsifiers.threshold: Falls back below 0.2800 while NDX rallies more than 1%
falsifiers.meaning: Would show capital flowing back into concentrated megacap/semis leadership, contradicting the defensive-rotation read.

regime.for_w52_engine: The NDX's 2.90% drop and SOX's 6.72% drop are not yet enough to flip the weekly W52 trend gate, but VIX at 19.03 (up 14.09%) is approaching levels that would compress exposure if the move extends into next week's close, and the semiconductor-heavy single-stock sleeve took the sharpest hit of the session.
regime.confidence_reason: Risk appetite and volatility axes agree on a risk-off tape, but liquidity signals conflict: the composite reads tightening (TGA up $68.6B, reserves down $59.5B) while the 10Y yield fell 19bps and TLT rose 1.87%, a flight-to-quality move that is easing for duration assets.
